Frequently Asked Questions (Professional Loan)

Clear answers to common questions about Professional Loan eligibility, process, and interest rates.

What is the difference between a Professional Term Loan and Overdraft?

A term loan gives you the lump sum amount with a fixed EMI, whereas an Overdraft (OD) limit gives you a pre-approved revolving credit limit where interest is charged only on the exact funds utilized and days used.

Is any collateral or clinic hypothecation needed?

No. Professional loans for Doctors and Chartered Accountants are 100% unsecured with zero collateral or asset mortgage required.

Can newly established doctors or CA firms apply?

Yes, doctors and CAs with minimum 2 years of practice registration or audited clinical vintage are eligible for fast-track credit sanctions.

Frequently Asked Questions (Working Capital)

Clear answers to common questions about Working Capital eligibility, process, and interest rates.

How does a Working Capital Overdraft work?

A credit limit (e.g. ₹50 Lakhs) is assigned to your business current account. You can withdraw and deposit funds freely, and interest is charged strictly on the net negative balance on a daily reducing basis.

Is collateral required for working capital?

Unsecured working capital lines up to ₹2 Crores are available based on GST turnover. For limits above ₹2 Crores, collateral options (property/machinery/FD) provide the lowest interest rates.

How often is the working capital limit renewed?

Working capital limits are sanctioned for 1 year and renewed annually based on ongoing audited financials and healthy banking turnover.

Frequently Asked Questions (CGT/MSME Loan)

Clear answers to common questions about CGTMSE collateral-free eligibility, 9.5% interest rate, and required documentation.

What is a CGT/MSME Loan?

A CGT/MSME loan is a specialized credit facility backed by the Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE), set up jointly by the Ministry of MSME, Government of India, and SIDBI. It enables registered micro and small enterprises to obtain credit facilities up to ₹5 Crores without pledging third-party property or collateral.

What is the interest rate (ROI) for CGT/MSME loans?

Interest rates for CGT/MSME loans through Proloan India partner banks start from 9.50% p.a. The final rate depends on business vintage, annual turnover, internal credit rating, and the chosen partner bank.

Do I need property collateral for a CGT/MSME loan?

No! The defining feature of the CGTMSE scheme is that loans up to ₹5 Crores are 100% collateral-free. The government trust provides guarantee cover of up to 75% to 85% to the lending institution against default risk.

Is Udyam Registration mandatory for applying?

Yes, having an active Udyam MSME Registration Certificate is a mandatory prerequisite to qualify under CGTMSE guidelines. If your unit is not registered yet, our credit advisors can guide you through the instant online Udyam process.

Can both manufacturing and service businesses apply?

Yes. Both manufacturing enterprises and service sector firms, as well as retail/wholesale traders registered under MSME, are fully eligible to avail CGT/MSME facilities for working capital, plant machinery, or business expansion.

Frequently Asked Questions (Education Loan)

Clear answers to common questions about Education Loan eligibility, process, and interest rates.

Does the education loan cover living expenses abroad?

Yes. Up to 100% funding covers tuition fees, hostel accommodation, meals, health insurance, airfare, books, and laptops.

When does repayment begin?

Repayment of principal begins only after the moratorium period ends — which is the entire course duration plus 6 to 12 months after course completion.

What are the tax benefits on an education loan?

Under Section 80E of the Income Tax Act, you can deduct the entire interest paid on an education loan from your taxable income with zero upper ceiling for 8 years.

Frequently Asked Questions (Machinery Loan)

Clear answers to common questions about Machinery Loan eligibility, process, and interest rates.

Can I finance imported or second-hand machinery?

Yes. Both new indigenous machinery and certified imported/refurbished equipment with residual useful life are eligible for financing.

Is collateral other than the machinery required?

In most cases, the hypothecation of the machinery itself serves as the primary security. Zero additional property collateral is required for loans up to ₹2 Crores.

How is the loan disbursed?

Disbursement is made directly to the equipment manufacturer/vendor against the certified proforma invoice and delivery proof.

5 Key Factors That Determine Your CIBIL Score

The 5 Crucial Factors That Determine Your Credit Score

CIBIL uses proprietary algorithmic weights. Focusing on the top two factors alone controls 65% of your final score.

history 35% Weight

Repayment Track Record

Consistency in paying credit card minimums and monthly loan EMIs on or before the due date. Even a single 30-day delay (DPD) can slash 40-70 points.

check Set auto-debit on salary accounts
pie_chart 30% Weight

Credit Utilization Ratio (CUR)

The percentage of your total available credit card limit used every billing cycle. Using more than 30% indicates credit hunger and increases lender risk.

check Keep card balances under 30% limit
hourglass_top 15% Weight

Credit History Age (Vintage)

The average age of all your open credit accounts. Older accounts with spotless payment histories build strong institutional credit reliability.

check Never close your oldest credit cards
account_balance 10% Weight

Credit Mix (Secured vs Unsecured)

A healthy balance of secured debt (Home Loans, Auto Loans, LAP) versus unsecured debt (Personal Loans, BNPL, Credit Cards) improves credit diversity.

check Avoid holding too many personal loans
find_in_page 10% Weight

Recent Hard Inquiries

Applying to multiple banks directly within a short timeframe triggers multiple "hard inquiries," which knocks off points. Proloan checks eligibility via soft inquiry.

check Use single-window DSA comparison

Important Regulatory Disclosures & Statutory Compliance Charter

RBI Master Directions on Credit Intermediation & Direct Selling Associates (DSA)

RBI-Regulated Partners DPDP Act 2023 256-Bit SSL Secure
corporate_fare 1. Intermediary & DSA Legal Nature

Proloan India operates solely as an authorized Direct Selling Associate (DSA) and credit facilitator for RBI-regulated Scheduled Commercial Banks, Housing Finance Companies (HFCs), and Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs). Proloan India is neither a bank nor an NBFC and does not grant, approve, or disburse loans directly. All credit evaluation, underwriting decisions, loan amounts, interest rates, and disbursals are at the sole discretion of partner lending institutions.

percent 2. Annual Percentage Rate (APR) Disclosures

Annual interest rates offered by partner lenders typically range from 8.35% p.a. to 24.00% p.a., with repayment tenures from 12 to 360 months based on borrower profile. Representative Example: For a loan of ₹10,00,000 at 9.50% p.a. for 5 years (60 months), monthly EMI is ₹21,002. Total interest payable is ₹2,60,113, resulting in a total repayment amount of ₹12,60,113 (statutory processing fees & taxes as applicable by bank).

security 3. Anti-Fraud & Zero Cash Advisory

Proloan India strictly adheres to ethical lending standards and NEVER asks borrowers for any upfront cash deposits, security charges, or private bank transfers. Always pay processing fees directly to the lender's designated corporate account upon receipt of an official sanction letter.

lock 4. Data Privacy & CIBIL Bureau Consent

In compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 and IT Act, 2000, all applicant information is encrypted using 256-bit SSL protocols and shared exclusively with designated banking partners for credit underwriting with borrower consent. We never sell, rent, or monetize applicant data.

Legal & Regulatory Documentation

ProLoan India • Registered Multi-Bank DSA & Credit Intermediary

Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023 & IT Act, 2000 Compliance

Privacy Policy & Borrower Data Protection Charter

Effective Date: 1st January 2026 | Last Updated: October 2026

At ProLoan India (referred to as "we", "our", "us"), respecting and guarding the privacy of your personal and financial information is our highest priority. This Privacy Policy governs the collection, processing, storage, and sharing of personal data obtained through our website, mobile interfaces, doorstep consultations, and customer care touchpoints.

1. Information We Collect

To evaluate your eligibility across 50+ Scheduled Commercial Banks and NBFCs, we collect:

  • Identity & Demographic Data: Full Name, Date of Birth, Gender, Father's/Spouse's Name, PAN, and Aadhaar (masked).
  • Contact Coordinates: Current and Permanent Residential Address, Mobile Number, and Email Address.
  • Financial & Employment Details: Salary slips, Form 16, ITR acknowledgments, business P&L accounts, bank account statements, employer name, business vintage, and registered GSTIN.
  • Credit History Information: Credit scores and bureau reports retrieved with your explicit consent from authorized credit information companies (CIBIL, Experian, CRIF High Mark, Equifax).
  • Property Documents: Title deeds, chain agreements, and sanction maps solely for valuation in Home Loans and LAP.
2. Purpose of Data Processing

Your data is processed strictly for legitimate loan facilitation activities:

  • Assessing loan eligibility and matching your profile with partner banks offering lowest interest rates.
  • Facilitating doorstep document collection, preliminary underwriting verification, and multi-bank file logins.
  • Communicating milestone progress, sanction letters, and disbursal updates via SMS, Phone, and WhatsApp.
  • Preventing fraud, identity theft, and ensuring compliance with Know Your Customer (KYC) guidelines.
3. Zero Data Sale Guarantee & Disclosure to Third Parties

We unequivocally guarantee that ProLoan India NEVER sells, rents, leases, or trades your personal information to third-party telemarketers or external advertising networks. Your documents and details are shared exclusively with:

  • Designated underwriting and credit operations teams of RBI-regulated partner banks and NBFCs where your loan file is submitted.
  • Licensed Credit Information Companies (CIBIL/Experian) upon your authorization for score retrieval.
  • Statutory, regulatory, or law enforcement authorities only when mandated under applicable Indian law.
4. Data Security & Storage Protocols

We implement industry-standard 256-bit SSL encryption for data transmission. Hardcopy photocopies collected during doorstep pickup are secured under dual-custody controls and dispatched directly to the evaluating lender. We never retain original property or identity documents.

5. Your Data Rights & Consent Withdrawal

As a data principal under the DPDP Act, you possess the right to access, review, correct, or request the purging of your stored personal data after conclusion of your loan process. You may revoke consent by emailing our Data Protection Officer at privacy@proloanindia.com.

DSA Service Agreement & Platform Terms

Terms & Conditions of Credit Facilitation

Please read these terms carefully before submitting your loan inquiry.

By accessing the ProLoan India portal, scheduling doorstep document pickup, or requesting loan evaluation, you ("Borrower", "User", "Applicant") accept and agree to be bound by the following Terms & Conditions.

1. Intermediary Status & Scope of Services

ProLoan India is an independent financial services consultancy operating as an authorized Direct Selling Associate (DSA). We act solely as a facilitator and matchmaker between borrowers and Scheduled Commercial Banks / NBFCs. ProLoan India does not grant, approve, or disburse credit from its own accounts.

2. Sole Discretion of Lending Institutions

The decision to sanction, condition, modify, or reject any loan application lies solely and exclusively within the underwriting authority of the respective lending bank or NBFC. ProLoan India does not guarantee loan approval or specific interest rates, as terms are decided by lenders based on borrower CIBIL score, income stability, and debt-to-income ratios.

3. Zero Upfront Cash Brokerage Policy

ProLoan India does not charge any upfront service fees, cash consultation charges, or private commissions from the borrower. Our doorstep advisory is 100% free. Any loan processing fees, property valuation charges, legal scrutiny fees, or stamp duty must be remitted directly to the designated bank's official account against a valid receipt or sanction letter.

4. Applicant Representations & Warranties

The applicant warrants that all information, declarations, KYC documents, financial statements, and business profiles furnished to ProLoan India are true, correct, authentic, and complete. Submission of falsified, forged, or altered documents will result in immediate disqualification and reporting to law enforcement authorities.

5. Limitation of Liability

ProLoan India and its representatives shall not be held liable for any delay in bank processing, rejection of loan applications, alteration in lender interest rate benchmarks (MCLR/EBLR/Repo rates), or consequential losses arising from bank underwriting determinations.

6. Jurisdiction & Dispute Resolution

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any legal dispute or controversy arising in connection with our services shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent civil courts at Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh.
